coordinate_selection.name: coordinate_selection
coordinate_selection.definition: Selecting the exact target source coordinate z* in I_match(x, D) when multiple candidates match (duplicate-token collision sequences).

opaque_id_ce_only.representation: Only scalar task ID t and sequence x are visible; token output y provides supervision.
opaque_id_ce_only.learning_requirement: Ill-posed / unidentifiable: token loss is symmetric across candidate coordinates, leaving H(Z|X, t, y) > 0.

contract_v1_1.representation: TieBreakPolicy in {FIRST, LAST, LEFTMOST, RIGHTMOST, CENTER} explicitly specified in D.
contract_v1_1.learning_requirement: Zero learning required to resolve ambiguity; the extremum rule is explicitly declared a priori, making H(Z|X, D) = 0.

deterministic_baseline_b_det.representation: Direct min() or max() selection over matching index list.
deterministic_baseline_b_det.learning_requirement: Zero parameters; exact extremum selection in O(1) time.

COND1_OPAQUE_ID_CE_ONLY.name: Opaque-ID / CE-only
COND1_OPAQUE_ID_CE_ONLY.task_observable: Scalar opaque task ID t in {0, ..., T-1}
COND1_OPAQUE_ID_CE_ONLY.loss_supervision: Cross-entropy loss L_CE(y_hat, y) on output tokens only
COND1_OPAQUE_ID_CE_ONLY.learned_parameters: Full model parameters (embedding + core + router + decoder)

formal_assessment.entropy_analysis: On collisions with 2 duplicates, candidate positions emit identical token V, yielding symmetric gradients and H(Z|X, t, y) = log2(2) = 1.0 bit > 0.
formal_assessment.world_separation_analysis: World A and B share identical token targets y_A=y_B=V on collisions; symmetric gradient descent yields identical or arbitrary coordinates with 0% guaranteed separation.
formal_assessment.unseen_relation_analysis: Unseen opaque task ID t_unseen has no trained representation; zero-shot transfer is mathematically impossible (0.0%).

COND2_CONTRACT_V1_1_SEMANTIC_DESCRIPTOR.name: Contract v1.1 Semantic Descriptor
COND2_CONTRACT_V1_1_SEMANTIC_DESCRIPTOR.task_observable: Structured AST tuple D = (OpFamily, Arguments, TieBreakPolicy) in L_desc
COND2_CONTRACT_V1_1_SEMANTIC_DESCRIPTOR.loss_supervision: Cross-entropy loss L_CE(y_hat, y) on output tokens only; content path isolated h_content = f(content)
COND2_CONTRACT_V1_1_SEMANTIC_DESCRIPTOR.learned_parameters: Full model parameters (descriptor encoder + core + router + decoder)

formal_assessment.entropy_analysis: Because TieBreakPolicy explicitly declares the extremum rule, z* is uniquely determined from (x, D). Residual uncertainty H(Z|X, D) is identically 0.0 bits.
formal_assessment.world_separation_analysis: D_A = (Op, Args, FIRST) != D_B = (Op, Args, LAST). Distinct task-conditioning vectors enable the router to separate attention coordinates under token CE loss alone.
formal_assessment.unseen_relation_analysis: For relations composed of known operations and arguments in L_desc, compositional zero-shot transfer is achievable if the neural router generalizes; novel primitive families require training.

COND3_DESCRIPTOR_ONLY_DETERMINISTIC_BASE.name: Descriptor-Only Deterministic Baseline (B_det / BASE-DET-DESC-V1)
COND3_DESCRIPTOR_ONLY_DETERMINISTIC_BASE.task_observable: Structured AST tuple D = (OpFamily, Arguments, TieBreakPolicy) in L_desc

formal_assessment.entropy_analysis: Reduction algorithm R(x, D) -> (z*, y) computes the exact coordinate and target in O(L) time; H(Z|X, D) = 0.0 bits.
formal_assessment.world_separation_analysis: Discrete evaluation of FIRST vs LAST selects exact ground-truth coordinates (z_A*=1, z_B*=3) with 100% precision and zero training.
formal_assessment.unseen_relation_analysis: 100% exact zero-shot execution for any relation composed in L_desc with implemented primitive handlers; raises NotImplementedError for novel unhandled operations.

controlled_ablations.name: TieBreakPolicy Masking
controlled_ablations.intervention: Mask TieBreakPolicy from descriptor: D -> D_masked = (OpFamily, Arguments, null)
controlled_ablations.causal_finding: TieBreakPolicy is the sole causal component in Contract v1.1 that eliminates coordinate ambiguity. When masked, H(Z|X, D) jumps from 0.0 to 1.0 bit, World A and World B become indistinguishable (D_A == D_B), and routing identifiability fails completely.

controlled_ablations.name: FIRST <-> LAST Counterfactual Swap
controlled_ablations.intervention: Hold sequence x=[10, 42, 10, 42] and Args={query_key: 10} strictly fixed, counterfactually swap TieBreakPolicy: FIRST <-> LAST
controlled_ablations.causal_finding: Swapping the tie-break policy shifts the target coordinate by 2 positions (1 <-> 3) with zero change in the target token y (42 == 42). This proves that coordinate selection is 100% causally driven by the descriptor symbol and 0% driven by token loss supervision.

controlled_ablations.name: Operation/Argument-Preserving Descriptor Permutation
controlled_ablations.intervention: Permute TieBreakPolicy across paired collision instances while preserving OpFamily=BIND and Arguments={query_key: 10}
controlled_ablations.causal_finding: Under fixed operation and arguments, coordinate selection tracks the permuted descriptor with 100% fidelity while sequence token content remains unchanged. Routing identity is dictated extrinsically by the descriptor syntax, rather than discovered intrinsically from data.

deterministic_baseline_dominance_audit.summary: B_det achieves 1.000 across all routing and execution metrics with 0 learned parameters, 0 training updates, and 0 residual routing uncertainty.

hypothesis_preservation_and_estimand_jud.rationale: H-C1 claimed that an oracle-free training contract can resolve routing identifiability under ambiguous token outputs through machine learning. However, Contract v1.1 eliminates the inverse routing problem a priori: by supplying TieBreakPolicy in D, the routing coordinate is a deterministic function of the input (H(Z|X, D) = 0) computable before seeing any token output. A 0-parameter deterministic baseline B_det achieves 100% accuracy on all criteria with zero learning. Thus, the estimand is fundamentally changed from 'learning routing from weak token supervision' to 'neural emulation of a known deterministic symbolic interpreter'.

estimand_comparison.original_h_c1_estimand: Inducing latent discrete routing coordinates from ambiguous token outputs y under opaque task context t via gradient descent on token cross-entropy loss.
estimand_comparison.contract_v1_1_transformed_estimand: Continuous neural compilation / function approximation of an a priori deterministic reduction algorithm R(x, D) whose routing coordinates are fully determined with H(Z|X, D) = 0.
estimand_comparison.scientific_consequence: Training a neural router under Contract v1.1 evaluates neural architecture approximation capacity, not routing identifiability from ambiguous token supervision.

hypothesis_preservation_and_estimand_jud.charter_action_detail: The current Phase C Charter candidate H-C1 must either be RETRACTED (as its original identifiability problem is trivialized by Contract v1.1) or RESTRICTED to a non-trivial residual learning problem with a precisely defined baseline delta.

residual_learning_problem_specification.problem_name: Continuous Neural Grounding & Zero-Shot Generalization of Structured Descriptors
residual_learning_problem_specification.unmet_criterion_by_b_det: B_det cannot execute relations outside its hard-coded Python dispatch table (raises NotImplementedError), and cannot process continuous distributed representations without symbolic parsing.
residual_learning_problem_specification.formal_definition: Given continuous sequence representations h_content(x) = f(x) and structured AST descriptor D in L_desc, can a continuous neural attention mechanism learn to ground symbolic arguments into sequence positions and execute algebraic tie-breaks under token CE loss alone, and generalize zero-shot to unseen composed relations without symbolic rule additions?

baseline_delta_definition.interpretation: B_det serves as the 1.000 contractual ceiling control. Any performance gap Delta_baseline < 0 in a learned neural model M isolates optimization failure, representation bottleneck, or generalization deficit, rather than task-specification ambiguity.

independent_blockers.detail: Contract v1.1 trivializes H-C1's original routing identifiability estimand via deterministic-baseline dominance (B_det achieves 1.000 EM and 0.0 bits uncertainty without learning).
